862-2511-5006-8170.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Crimson Kobolds is starting in your graveyard.
862-2511-5006-8170.description:
Cast Crimson Kobolds by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Crimson Kobolds spell. Then, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bloodflow Connoisseur
Repeat.

437-4613-5475.easyPrerequisites:
Sphinx's Disciple doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Forensic Researcher is exiled by Agatha's Soul Cauldron.
437-4613-5475.notablePrerequisites: You control another creature that doesn't have summoning sickness and has a +1/+1 counter on it.
437-4613-5475.description:
Activate Sphinx's Disciple using Forensic Researcher's ability by tapping it, untapping another creature you control that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate the other creature using Forensic Researcher's ability by tapping it, untapping Sphinx's Disciple
Sphinx's Disciple triggers, drawing a card.
Repeat.

539-2921-3821-4679-6023.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-2921-3821-4679-6023.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, putting a +1/+1 counter on Bartolomé del Presidio.
Repeat

225-2645-3430-5928.easyPrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant doesn't have summoning sickness.
225-2645-3430-5928.description:
Activate Balduvian Trading Post by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Balduvian Trading Post
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4770-6090-6633-6723.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

647-4289-4770-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

141-4050-5100.easyPrerequisites: There's a creature card in your graveyard.
141-4050-5100.description:
Cast Return Upon the Tide by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Return Upon the Tide.
Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Naru Meha, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Return Upon the Tide
Resolve the Return Upon the Tide copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

969-3490-7075-7763.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature token that has not been tapped this turn.
969-3490-7075-7763.description:
Activate a creature token by tapping it, adding {1}.
The creature's ability granted to it by Tale of Katara and Toph triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on the creature.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Repeat.

803-4247-5310-6879.description:
Cast Bloodghast by paying {B}{B}.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing Bloodghast.
Activate Bloodthrone Vampire by sacrificing a land creature.
When the land creature dies, Haru triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When the land enters, Bloodghast triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Bloodghast enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending a land.
Resolve the Bloodthrone Vampire ability from step 4.
Repeat from step 3.
803-4247-5310-6879.notes: If the chosen land can enter untapped and produce mana, you may do so each iteration to get infinite mana of those color(s) and type(s).

1170-1976-5131-5330--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-1976-5131-5330--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Etherium Sculptor.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Muldrotha, allowing you to use its ability again this turn.
Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Atog by sacrificing the artifact, giving Atog +2/+2 until end of turn
Repeat.

757-5087-6995-7798.easyPrerequisites: Magosi has at least one eon counter on it and does not have summoning sickness.
757-5087-6995-7798.description:
During your precombat main phase, use Lulu to put an additional eon counter on Magosi.
Activate Magosi's third ability by tapping it, removing an eon counter from it and returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
When Magosi leaves the battlefield, The Ozolith's first ability triggers due to Natural Emergence, putting an eon counter on The Ozolith.
Resolve the Magosi ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Play Magosi.
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Ozolith triggers, moving an eon counter from itself onto Magosi.
Repeat each turn.

301-2813-7804.easyPrerequisites: There's an artifact on the battlefield.
301-2813-7804.notablePrerequisites: The top card of your library is a nonland card.
301-2813-7804.description:
Activate Goblin Trashmaster by sacrificing Putrid Goblin
When Putrid Goblin dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
When Putrid Goblin enters, Captain Kathryn Janeway triggers, revealing the top card of your library, putting a +1/+1 counter on Putrid Goblin and then putting the card back on top of your library.
Resolve the Goblin Trashmaster ability.
Repeat.

360-1895-4399-4518.description:
Cast Kor Skyfisher by paying {0} and 2 life due to Defiler of Faith and Pearl Medallion.
Defiler of Faith triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Soul Warden triggers, causing you to gain life.
Resolve Kor Skyfisher. When it enters, it and Soul Warden trigger.
Resolve the Kor Skyfisher trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Soul Warden trigger, causing you to gain life.
Repeat.
360-1895-4399-4518.notes: If your life total is below 3 to start, instead pay {W} when casting Kor Skyfisher for the first time.

as a copy of Radiant Solar

670-1619-1974-5399.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to cause a creature to enter the battlefield under your control.
You are not currently venturing in a dungeon.
670-1619-1974-5399.description:
Put any nontoken creature onto the battlefield.
When the creature enters, Radiant Solar, Quicksilver Gargantuan and Pirated Copy each trigger.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, causing you to venture into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Quicksilver Gargantuan trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice Radiant Solar.
Resolve the Pirated Copy trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning Radiant Solar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
670-1619-1974-5399.notes: If you are currently venturing in a dungeon when starting the combo, you can complete the dungeon and then use Sefris' second ability to put a creature onto the battlefield to start the combo.

215-6478-7175.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with toughness 6 or greater.
215-6478-7175.description:
Activate Arbor Adherent by tapping it, adding an amount of {G}.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Arbor Adherent from the battlefield to your hand.
Cast Arbor Adherent by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

1298-1636-7542.easyPrerequisites:
You control a creature that can tap to produce at least {U}.
You control two untapped creatures excluding the mana-producing creature and Harmonized Trio.
1298-1636-7542.description:
Activate a creature by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Activate Harmonized Trio by tapping it and two other creatures you control, causing it to become prepared.
Cast a copy of Brainstorm by paying {U}.
Ovika triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve Brainstorm, causing you to draw three cards and put two cards from your hand onto the top of your library.
Repeat.

883-2469-5220-6900.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Ashes of the Abhorrent trigger, causing you to gain 1 life
Repeat.

2724-4006-4499.description:
Blink Wormfang Manta using Emiel the Blessed. Wormfang Manta's first ability won't trigger due to Hushbringer.
Wormfang Manta's second ability triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

813-4050-7364.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Scholar of the Ages and another nontoken creature, adding {1}{W}.
Cast Continue? by paying {1}{W}, returning Scholar of the Ages and at least one other creature from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Scholar of the Ages enters, it triggers, returning Continue? from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
813-4050-7364.notes: You can sacrifice up to two additional creatures each loop to net mana.

2866-4708-4986-5330.description:
Cast Dark Sphere by paying its mana cost.
Teshar triggers, returning Scrap Trawler from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate Dark Sphere by tapping and sacrificing it.
Activate Atog by sacrificing Scrap Trawler.
When Scrap Trawler dies, it triggers, returning Dark Sphere from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Atog ability.
Repeat.

4375-4779-5400.description:
Cast Technomancer by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Technomancer enters, it triggers, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
When Synth Infiltrator enters, it triggers. Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Synth Infiltrator.
Resolve the Synth Infiltrator trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Synth Infiltrator from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Technomancer.
Repeat from step 3.

4275-5470-6798.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to create a Human creature token, a Shaman creature token, and/or a creature token with changeling this turn.
4275-5470-6798.description:
Create a creature token that is a Human and/or Shaman, and/or has changeling.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the creature token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token created in step 2.
When the creature token dies, Faces of the Past triggers, untapping all creatures that share a creature type with it.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability
Repeat from step 2.

2281-2757-5006-6797.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one basic Forest.
You control at least one basic Plains.
2281-2757-5006-6797.description:
Activate a basic Forest and Plains by tapping them, adding {G}{W}.
Activate Earthcraft twice by tapping Lurrus and Saffi, untapping the basic Forest and Plains.
Activate Saffi by sacrificing it, targeting Lurrus.
Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Lurrus.
When Lurrus dies, Saffi triggers, returning Lurrus from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability
Cast Saffi from your graveyard by paying {G}{W}.
Repeat.

4112-4375-5686.description:
Cast Sharuum either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {3}{W}{U}{B} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Sharuum enters the battlefield, it triggers, targeting Technomancer.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Sharuum.
Resolve the Sharuum trigger, returning Technomancer from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Technomancer enters the battlefield, it triggers.
Holding priority, activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Technomancer.
Resolve the Technomancer trigger, causing you to mill three cards and return Sharuum from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

570-5200.notablePrerequisites: There are at least four colors among permanents you control.
570-5200.description:
Activate Faeburrow Elder by tapping it, adding at least {2}{G}{W}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {3}, untapping Faeburrow Elder.
Repeat.
570-5200.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may equip Sword of the Paruns to any creature you control and untap them infinite times.

974-3750-5470.notablePrerequisites: There and Back Again has exactly two lore counters on it.
974-3750-5470.description:
At the beginning of your precombat main phase, There and Back Again triggers, putting a lore counter on it.
There and Back Again's third chapter ability triggers, creating a legendary 6/6 Smaug creature token and causing you to sacrifice There and Back Again.
Activate Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Smaug token.
Put either Smaug token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
When the Smaug token dies, it triggers, creating fourteen Treasure tokens.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat from step 3.
974-3750-5470.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may instead use Ghired to copy any other token(s) that entered the battlefield under your control this turn.

4880-5149-5200.easyPrerequisites: Power Artifact attached to Sword of the Paruns.
4880-5149-5200.notablePrerequisites:
Weaver of Currents does not have summoning sickness.
Sword of the Paruns attached to Weaver of Currents
4880-5149-5200.description:
Activate Weaver of Currents by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Sword of the Paruns by paying {1}, untapping Weaver of Currents.
Repeat.
4880-5149-5200.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you may attach Sword of the Paruns to any other creature(s) to untap them.

527-876-4790.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with power 7 or greater.
527-876-4790.description:
Activate Dino DNA by paying {6}, creating a token copy of Selvala that is a 6/6 Dinosaur.
If you control two Selvala tokens, put the oldest token into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Activate Lightning Greaves' equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to the Selvala token.
Activate the Selvala token by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {6}{G}.
Repeat.
If you control a creature with power 8 or greater, this combo nets infinite mana.

245-1912-2034.description:
Activate Marneus by paying {4}, creating two 2/2 Astartes Warrior creature tokens.
The tokens enter the battlefield, triggering Marneus, causing you to draw a card.
Activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing both Astartes Warriors, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Repeat.

5-2232-2757-3474.description:
Activate a basic Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Cast Oviya Pashiri by paying {G}.
Oviya Pashiri enters the battlefield, triggering Jedit Ojanen and Cloudstone Curio.
Holding priority, activate Earthcraft by tapping Oviya Pashiri, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate a basic Forest you control by tapping it, adding {G}.
Resolve the Cloudstone Curio trigger, choosing not to return anything from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Jedit Ojanen trigger, causing you to pay {G} to create a 2/2 Cat Warrior creature token.
The Cat Warrior enters the battlefield, triggering Cloudstone Curio, returning Oviya Pashiri from the battlefield to your hand.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping the Cat Warrior token, untapping a basic Forest.
Repeat.

765-1530-3293.notablePrerequisites: Your life total is five or less.
765-1530-3293.description:
At the beginning of your upkeep, Second Chance triggers, causing you to sacrifice it and take an extra turn after this one.
Play Guildless Commons from your hand.
Guildless Commons enters the battlefield, triggering itself and Emeria Shepherd.
Resolve the Guildless Commons trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Shepherd trigger, returning Second Chance from your graveyard to your hand.
Cast Second Chance by paying {2}{U}.
Repeat each turn.

1335-2744-3062-5296.notablePrerequisites:
Marath has at least two +1/+1 counters on it.
Workhorse has at least one +1/+1 counters on it.
1335-2744-3062-5296.description:
Activate Marath by paying {1}, creating a 1/1 Elemental token.
Cathars' Crusade triggers putting two +1/+1 counter to all creatures you control.
Activate Workhorse by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
